text: Muñño, an Nulaaɗo, e ko yimɓe maa lorrete ɓe fenne kon. Pellet, ko Allah fodu maa wallude kon, ko goonga, mo sikke alaa e mu'un. Ko si Men holle yoga e ko Men kammbirani ɓe kon e lepte, e nguurndam maa, wano feƴƴirnoo ka hare Badri, maa hara Men ƴettite ado mun, fow e mun, ko ka Amen tun, woni ruttorde maɓɓe, Ñalnde Darngal, Men yoɓa ɓe golle maɓɓe ɗen, Men naatnaɓe ka Yiite, ɓe lutta ton poomaa.
